appName: The Miracle of 4 Minutes: CPR Training
displayName: The Miracle of 4 Minutes: CPR Training
display_name: The Miracle of 4 Minutes: CPR Training
display_long_description:
When cardiac arrest occurs, the blood circulation stops immediately. And if the blood supply to our brain is interrupted for just four to five minutes, it can lead to permanent damage. By experiencing and learning about CPR through this game, we hope to contribute to the society by improving everyone's ability to respond to patients who need CPR.
You can experience first-hand various scenarios where cardiac arrest may occur in daily life, such as a cardiac arrest in subways, an electrocution at a construction site, and cardiac arrest while exercising at the gym. You can also indirectly experience a Code Blue and take control of a CPR situation in a hospital.
As this game is played with the patient lying down, using the dummy to practice before starting the game is recommended. If there is no dummy available, you can practice using other objects such as a pillow, cushion or dolls.
